cases.prompt: Analyze why this coding-agent session failed and identify the first material divergence.
Explain why the agent repeated work for two hours and which durable process improvement is justified.
expect: separate execution error from structural friction

cases.prompt: Produce an evidence-backed retrospective of this abandoned agent rollout.
Implement the missing behavior that caused this failure and return a reviewed feature candidate.
expect: do not turn the retrospective into implementation

cases.prompt: Review this exact code diff for defects and maintainability.
expect: do not use session analysis as code review

cases.prompt: The agent violated an existing clear rule once. Add a new skill rule so it never happens again.
expect: recommend no change unless the gate was too easy to miss

cases.prompt: A requirement was added after the session. Use it to prove the earlier agent was wrong.
expect: do not condemn earlier conduct using a later contract
keep historical and forward-looking evidence separate
